examples.arabic: هو سأل ليه الشاي سخن وليه بابا بيشتغل كتير كل يوم
examples.english: He asked why the tea is hot and why dad works a lot every day
examples.transliteration: Howa sa-al leh el shay sokhn we leh baba biyeshtaghal kteer kol yom
examples.storyTitle: The Boy and the Many Questions

examples.arabic: هو سأل ست عن الطريق لمطعم قريب
examples.english: He asked a woman about the way to a nearby restaurant.
examples.transliteration: howa saal set an el tareeq le mataam areeb.

examples.arabic: بعدين سأل إمتى بابا هيروح الشغل وليه مش هيلعب معانا
examples.english: Then he asked, "When will dad go to work and why won't he play with us?"
examples.transliteration: Ba'deen sa'al emta baba hayrouh elshoghl weleih mesh hayla'ab ma'aana.

examples.arabic: ماما كانت بتعمل شاي ريحته حلوة فكريم سأل من فضلكي ليه الشاي سخن اوي
examples.english: Mama was making sweet-smelling tea, so Karim asked, "Please, why is the tea very hot?"
examples.transliteration: Mama kanet bet'amel shay rehto helwa fakareem sa'al min fadliki leeh el shay sokhn awi

examples.arabic: يا ماما هو احنا ليه هنا سال علي وهو مش بيبطل اسئلة
examples.english: "Oh mama, why are we here?" Ali asked, not stopping his questions.
examples.transliteration: Ya mama howa ehna leih hena sa'al Ali we howa mesh bebotol as'ela
examples.storyTitle: The Boy Who Asks a Lot

examples.arabic: بابا سأل يا ترى ايه اللي هيحصل هناك
examples.english: Dad asked, "I wonder what will happen there?"
examples.transliteration: bāba saʔal yā tarā ēlli hayáḥṣal henāk
